component.name: Astraea
component.summary: Calendario e agenda sincronizzati via Nostr

description.p: Astraea is an offline-first, privacy-first calendar. Events are stored locally, end-to-end encrypted with your own Nostr key (NIP-44), and synchronized through Nostr relays — no account, no server of ours, the same calendar on your phone and your desktop.

Astraea è un calendario offline-first e privacy-first. Gli eventi sono salvati in locale, cifrati end-to-end con la tua chiave Nostr (NIP-44) e sincronizzati attraverso i relay Nostr — nessun account, nessun nostro server, lo stesso calendario su telefono e desktop.
The Linux desktop version ships a background service with a D-Bus API, a GNOME Shell extension with agenda and quick event creation in the top bar, and browser-based login with any NIP-07 extension.

screenshot.caption: Month view with the calendars sidebar

description.p: Attendee invites: invite another Astraea account (by npub, hex public key, or NIP-05) to an event, with accept/decline and desktop notifications. Full app localization into all 27 EU official languages plus Chinese, Japanese and Russian, with a language picker. Desktop Settings now fully wired to the background service (browser login, relays, live sync status). Personal relay support for unencrypted-transport (ws://) home/self-hosted relays.
First Linux desktop release: background service with D-Bus API, Flutter desktop app, GNOME Shell extension, browser (NIP-07) login, encrypted Nostr synchronization.
